'''Gwadj''' was a [[Bordal]]i agent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He commanded a mission to [[Kuan]] which captured [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek]] and [[Marina Stele]], along with [[Pargo]]. However, on the way back to Bordal, the Bordali [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was captured by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance II|''Vengeance'']], and Gwadj was taken prisoner.<ref name="Stele Chronicles" />
